rationale: The answer covers all three key points. (1) Creation: APs deliver a basket of securities or cash to the fund and receive newly issued shares, which increases shares outstanding. (2) Redemption: APs return shares to the fund, which cancels them, which decreases shares outstanding. (3) Exchange trading between investors does not change shares outstanding. Mentioning cash creations and redemptions and creation units is accurate extra detail. There are no material errors.
